title: Baarle: The Border Treaty That Says 'The Limit Is Interrupted'

beats.say: One border treaty reaches a town, and simply writes: the limit is interrupted.
beats.caption: 1843 treaty, at Baarle: “the limit is interrupted”

beats.say: That treaty, from eighteen forty-three, set the border between the Netherlands and Belgium.
beats.caption: Netherlands–Belgium boundary treaty · 1843

beats.say: But at Baarle, an older deal said the status quo must stay.
beats.caption: 1842 treaty, Art. 14: the status quo stays at Baarle

beats.say: So no line was drawn there. Today, the map shows thirty enclaves.
beats.caption: 30 enclaves today (official maps)

beats.say: Twenty-two are Belgian pieces, inside the Netherlands.
beats.caption: 22 Belgian enclaves inside Dutch land

beats.say: And six Dutch pieces sit inside the biggest Belgian one.
beats.caption: 6 Dutch pieces inside the largest Belgian enclave (165 ha)

beats.say: In eighteen ninety-two, both governments agreed a land swap to end this. Belgium's bill lapsed.
beats.caption: 1892 swap deal · Belgian bill lapsed in 1894

beats.say: All because one treaty wrote: the limit is interrupted.
beats.caption: Treaty of 1843: “the limit is interrupted”
